race.comment: Good race with plenty of hopes but keen on the chances of GEEGEES MISSILE (4). Ready to win after two runs back, the latest a nose behind BILLIE THE GREAT here. Can turn the tables. COOL HEART (7) is also ready to win, placing at both runs this campaign. Returns to the turf and is a course and distance winner. Gets chance. BILLIE THE GREAT (6) gave a sight and held on to score over a number of these last time. Slightly more weight and can give a sight again. SKY LAND (5)  was well off best last time but has the senior rider back aboard and off the low draw will take catching. WILD NIGHTS (9) is drawn for a good run and is among the chances.
